questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses inversion to emphasize the adverbial clause.
options: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to clean the garden.
Only after the rain had stopped they began to clean the garden.
Only after the rain had stopped, they began to clean the garden.
Only after the rain had stopped; they began to clean the garden.
questions.answer: Only after the rain had stopped did they begin to clean the garden.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a cleft sentence to highlight the location?
options: It was in the old library that the historian discovered the rare manuscript.
It was in the old library where the historian discovered the rare manuscript.
It was in the old library when the historian discovered the rare manuscript.
It was in the old library since the historian discovered the rare manuscript.
questions.answer: It was in the old library that the historian discovered the rare manuscript.

questions.question: Select the option that correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical scenario.
options: If I were you, I would have accepted the job.
If I was you, I would have accepted the job.
If I had been you, I would have accepted the job.
If I am you, I would have accepted the job.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would have accepted the job.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly demonstrates ellipsis to avoid repetition?
options: She doesn't like coffee, whereas her brother does.
She doesn't like coffee, whereas her brother does not.
She doesn't like coffee, whereas her brother doesn't.
She doesn't like coffee, whereas her brother likes.
questions.answer: She doesn't like coffee, whereas her brother does.

questions.question: Identify the sentence that appropriately uses a complex sentence structure with multiple clauses to convey a nuanced meaning.
options: Although the project was challenging, the team completed it on time because they worked efficiently and collaborated well.
Although the project was challenging, the team completed it on time because they worked efficiently and collaboration well.
Although the project was challenging, the team completed it on time because they worked efficiently and collaborated well.
Although the project was challenging, the team completed it on time because they worked efficiently and collaborated well.
questions.answer: Although the project was challenging, the team completed it on time because they worked efficiently and collaborated well.
